metadata.description: The CDP5 way of working as a Claude Code marketplace: deterministic T1 skills, judgment agents under a shared worker contract, domain knowledge packs, Orbit session hook.

plugins.name: cdp5-gates
plugins.description: Read-only deterministic T1 skills per CDP5 §32.9: konzept-lint with the shipped maturity policy, konzept-mapper, konzept-model-api, ac-to-test-scaffold, test-gap, roadmap-drift, retro-memory-loop-check, wiki-lint, mcp-config-lint, mcp-doc-drift-gate, secrets-scan, pii-scan, profile-check, skill-lint, cdp5-init, cdp5-reference. Programs, no LLM; one exit-code and severity convention.

plugins.name: cdp5-agents
plugins.description: CDP5 agents, the orchestrate skill and cdp5-doctor: nine judgment and counter-roles (konzept-reviewer, review-verify, adversarial-auditor, threat-modeler, mcp-security-reviewer, devils-advocate, pessimistic-realist, review-code, pm-retro), three implementation workers (impl-debug, impl-uc, impl-refactor); worker contract via hooks, allowlist shell guard with human-confirmed run grants, worktree-setup and grant-run, host check.

plugins.name: domain-agents
plugins.description: Domain agents and session skills with shipped knowledge packs: marketing-strategist, psy-domaenen-rechercheur, psy-grenzwaechter; business-lingo (89 entries, frameworks, lenses), psy-knowledge, three psy session skills, marketing-knowledge, ux-knowledge (118 entries). Requires cdp5-agents; stops its agents with CONTRACT-MISSING when it is absent.

plugins.name: orbit-workflow
plugins.description: SessionStart hook that loads the latest Orbit report and the open FastNotes of the current project into every Claude Code session (startup, resume, clear, compact), with a local cache when Orbit is unreachable.
